eps.d: The CID officers from Brazen Gate police station investigate the apparently motiveless murderof a terminally-ill man shot dead at a cancer hospital.
CID officers Rebecca and Warren try to solve a case where a corpse appears to have opened his own mail
The team investigates pornography being sold to children.
When a woman is found dead at a bus stop just yardsfrom her home, Ron and Marty find the neighbours very unhelpful.
Bruce is involved in a potentially explosive investigation. Franky, frustrated at being deskbound, conducts his own enquiry with tragic results.
Tensions run high at Brazen Gate as the CID team searches for the killer of one of its own.
When a toddler goes missing, Brazen Gate CID are divided in their opinions about his teenage parents.
Jim Lewyn displays his true nature as he pursues the killer of a company boss with enemies close to home.
The team must confront its own prejudices after a man is seriously assaulted.
When the Crown Prosecution Service fails to prosecute a known drugs dealer, Tommy Defty , Bruce and Lew are determined to bring him tojustice using any means possible.
A homeless person is found beaten to death after several others have been poisoned.
When a 15-year-old girl is found dead, Lew investigates why she turned to prostitution.
